ResolutionExpression.representation: Static candidate source-binding expression, not native input or production architecture
ResolutionExpression.binding: Namespace and resolved relation must match complete typed pg_namespace/pg_class candidate rows. No callback variant exists in this specification.
ResolutionExpression.RESOLVED_OID_projection: Total tagged projection: EXACT_FROZEN_IDENTITY -> relation_oid; NAMESPACE_NAME_LOOKUP -> resolved_relation_oid. No absent-field read.

EffectLeaf.representation: Typed design projection of source-expanded candidate effect metadata, not an installed effect or raw SQL command
EffectLeaf.normalization: For kind WRITE_RESOURCE derive a candidate WRITE_RESOURCE edge from source Reader R to the exact named resource; FIXED_PROJECTION derives only its declared read/projection effect. Authoritative expected source manifest is not replaced.

encoding.header: magic8 || version u16be || message_type u16be || sender_actor u16be || recipient_actor u16be || payload_length u32be
encoding.payload: field_count u16be; ascending contiguous fields: tag u16be || length u32be || exact typed value; no presence byte because every field is required/non-null
encoding.signature: 64-byte Ed25519 signature over ASCII FLOOOW/PACKAGE0090/R5N/TEST/V1 followed by complete header+payload; fixed algorithm; expected key looked up by enrolled role/purpose/generation, never selected by caller credential_ref
encoding.integers: Unsigned fixed-width big-endian u16/u32/u64; signed i64 is exactly8-byte big-endian two-complement in range -2^63..2^63-1. Overflow/range violation rejects; sequence/generation/revisions checked before increment
encoding.text: Strict UTF8 NFC already normalized, no control/NUL/empty; reject rather than normalize
encoding.bytes: bytes32 and bytes64 exact raw length
encoding.arrays: u32be count then u32be element length and exact canonical typed element; sets sort full unsigned bytes and reject duplicates; bounded <=4096 entries
encoding.unknown: Unknown version/type/field, missing/extra/duplicate/out-of-order tag, invalid width, truncation/MSG_TRUNC/MSG_CTRUNC, trailing bytes or excess ancillary => reject before work
encoding.nonresult: Challenge result_code=0 NOT_A_RESULT and result_digest=SHA256(ASCII FLOOOW/R5N/NO-RESULT/V1); never an observed outcome
encoding.time: Original CLOCK_BOOTTIME microseconds=floor(clock_gettime(CLOCK_BOOTTIME) nanoseconds/1000) in same boot_id/time namespace. server_start_epoch_us is signed finite PostgreSQL microseconds since2000-01-01T00:00:00Z, matching frozen PgStartTime/pg_stat_activity conversion, not Unix1970; reject PostgreSQL infinity sentinels. Approval signed-window wall time preserves original canonical UTC encoding and authoritative independently observed database clock; never compare it directly to BOOTTIME. Immutable policy gives finite positive max age, work deadline, key validity and heartbeat frame limits; numeric values remain independently approved provisioning data; time/nonce never authority
encoding.schema_JSON: For expected_result_schema_digest only: exact declared field-schema array with object keys sorted ASCII lexicographically, arrays in declared order, UTF8 bytes, no BOM/newline/whitespace. Allowed values are printable ASCII strings, booleans true/false and exact nonnegative integers<=9007199254740991; no null/float/nonfinite/negative/duplicate keys. Decimal integers no leading zeros; strings escape only quote and backslash, slash is unescaped. This restricted domain is exactly json.dumps(schema,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False).encode(UTF8) for these schema objects. SHA256 those exact bytes; schema digest is design data, never binary identity

codec_encoding: For each named schema: u32be ASCII domain byte length || exact domain FLOOOW/PACKAGE0090/R5N/IDENTITY/{schema_name}/V1 || u16be field count || contiguous tag u16be,length u32be,value in declared order; required/non-null exact widths, big-endian integer/UUID rules as native-message-abi. Digest=SHA256 complete frame; no normalization, default or unknown field
